title: 50 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Ordering Food & Dining)
description:
Learn 50 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 50 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Ordering Food & Dining · 点餐与用餐
1:14  Celebrations & Parties · 庆祝活动与派对
2:34  Kindness · 善良
3:51  Hope · 希望
5:11  Strength · 力量
6:25  Dating & Romance · 约会与浪漫
7:45  Success · 成功
9:11  Family & Home · 家庭与家居

PHRASE LIST

ORDERING FOOD & DINING · 点餐与用餐
• What comes with this dish? - 这道菜配什么？  [Zhè dào cài pèi shénme?]
• Can I get extra rice? - 我可以多要点米饭吗？  [Wǒ kěyǐ duō yào diǎn mǐfàn ma?]
• Do you have gluten-free? - 你们有无麸质的吗？  [Nǐmen yǒu wú fū zhì de ma?]
• May I have it vegetarian-style? - 可以做成素食的做法吗？  [Kěyǐ zuò chéng sùshí de zuòfǎ ma?]
• Is this sauce soy-based? - 这酱是用的酱油吗？  [Zhè jiàng shì yòng de jiàngyóu ma?]
• I want it less salty, please. - 我想要少盐一点。  [Wǒ xiǎng yào shǎo yán yìdiǎn.]

CELEBRATIONS & PARTIES · 庆祝活动与派对
• I saved you a seat - 我给你留了个座位  [Wo gei ni liu le ge zuowei]
• Let’s make a toast together - 我们一起举杯吧  [Women yiqi ju bei ba]
• Tonight’s theme is coming alive - 今晚的主题要嗨起来了  [Jin wan de zhu ti yao hai qi lai le]
• Thanks for hosting, I’m excited - 谢谢你当东道主，我很期待  [Xie xie ni dang dong dao zhu, wo hen qi dai]
• Where’s the dance floor? - 舞池在哪儿？  [Wu chi zai nar]
• Can we do a quick cheers? - 我们先碰个杯可以吗  [Women xian peng ge bei ke yi ma]
• Do we need RSVPs? - 还需要回信确认人数吗  [Huan xu yao hui xin que ren ren shu ma]

KINDNESS · 善良
• Make room for people’s feelings - 给别人的感受留点空间  [Gěi Biérén De Gǎnshòu Lǜ Diǎn Kōngjiān]
• Kindness starts with your tone - 善意先从你的语气开始  [Shànyì Xiān Cóng Nǐ De Yǔqì Kāishǐ]
• Offer help before they ask - 在他们开口前先帮一把  [Zài Tāmen Kāikǒu Qián Xiān Bāng Yì Bǎ]
• Slow down, be gentle today - 今天慢一点, 温柔一点  [Jīntiān Màn Yì Diǎn, Wēnróu Yì Diǎn]
• Let them save face in public - 当众也给他留点面子  [Dāngzhòng Yě Gěi Tā Liú Diǎn Miànzi]
• I’ll speak up, but kindly - 我可以说出来, 但会很温和  [Wǒ Kěyǐ Shuō Chūlái, Dàn Huì Hěn Wēnhé]

HOPE · 希望
• Hope is showing up, little by little. - 希望在慢慢靠近我。  [Xīwàng zài mànmàn kàojìn wǒ.]
• I can start again with kindness. - 我可以带着温柔重新开始。  [Wǒ kěyǐ dàizhe wēnróu chóngxīn kāishǐ.]
• There’s room for better, even now. - 就算现在也还有更好的空间。  [Jiù suàn xiànzài yě hái yǒu gèng hǎo de kōngjiān.]
• My heart learns to trust tomorrow. - 我的心会学会相信明天。  [Wǒ de xīn huì xuéhuì xiāngxìn míngtiān.]
• I breathe, then choose hope again. - 我先呼吸，再选择希望。  [Wǒ xiān hūxī, zài xuǎnzé xīwàng.]
• Even hard days can move forward. - 再难的日子也能往前走。  [Zài nán de rìzi yě néng wǎngqián zǒu.]

STRENGTH · 力量
• I can take one more step. - 我还能再迈一步，  [Wǒ hái néng zài mài yì bù,.]
• I stand back up after setbacks. - 我会在挫折后站起来，  [Wǒ huì zài cuòzhé hòu zhàn qǐlái,.]
• My voice is steadier now. - 我现在的声音更稳了，  [Wǒ xiànzài de shēngyīn gèng wěn le,.]
• I keep promises to myself. - 我会对自己守信用，  [Wǒ huì duì zìjǐ shǒu xìnyòng,.]
• I face the day, not the worst. - 我面对今天，而不是最坏的情况，  [Wǒ miànduì jīntiān, ér búshì zuì huài de qíngkuàng,.]
• I set boundaries and breathe. - 我立下界限，然后深呼吸，  [Wǒ lìxià jièxiàn, ránhòu shēn hūxī,.]

DATING & ROMANCE · 约会与浪漫
• Meet me by the bookstore, okay? - 我们在书店那边见，好吗？  [Wo MEN zai SHU dian na bian jian, hao ma?]
• Pick your favorite dessert tonight. - 今晚你选你最喜欢的甜点吧。  [Jin WAN ni xuan ni zui xi huan de tian dian ba]
• Want to dance, no experience needed. - 想跳舞吗, 不用会也行。  [Xiang tiao wu ma, bu yong hui ye xing]
• Let’s do a cute couple photo. - 我们来拍一组像情侣一样的照片吧。  [Wo MEN lai pai yi zu xiang qing lv yi yang de zhao pian ba]
• Your hand fits mine perfectly. - 你牵着我的手，刚刚好。  [Ni qian zhe wo de shou, gang gang hao]
• Movie first, then we stroll. - 先看电影, 然后我们散散步。  [Xian kan dian ying, ran hou wo MEN san san bu]

SUCCESS · 成功
• Success comes from showing up early. - 成功来自你早到一步的投入。  [Chénggōng láizì nǐ zǎodào yībù de tóurù.]
• I choose focus over worry today. - 今天我选择专注，别让担心占上风。  [Jīntiān wǒ xuǎnzé zhuānzhù, bié ràng dānxīn zhàn shàngfēng.]
• One goal, then I move. - 一个目标，接着就行动。  [Yí gè mùbiāo, jiēzhe jiù xíngdòng.]
• Keep it simple, do it anyway. - 别想太复杂，先把该做的做了。  [Bié xiǎng tài fùzá, xiān bǎ gāi zuò de zuò le.]
• Today I earn confidence with effort. - 今天我用努力换来更稳的自信。  [Jīntiān wǒ yòng nǔlì huànlái gèng wěn de zìxìn.]
• I learn fast when I try, not freeze. - 我一尝试就学得快，别再僵着不动。  [Wǒ yì chángshì jiù xué de kuài, bié zài jiāngzhe bù dòng.]

FAMILY & HOME · 家庭与家居
• Home feels warmer when you're here - 你在的时候，家里更温暖  [Nǐ zài de shíhou, jiālǐ gèng wēnnuǎn]
• Can we cook dinner together tonight? - 今晚一起做饭吧  [Jīnwǎn yìqǐ zuò fàn ba]
• Kitchen is my happy place - 厨房是我最开心的地方  [Chúfáng shì wǒ zuì kāixīn de dìfang]
